title: Properness descends along a single surjective flat quasi-compact morphism (proved source instance)
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme], the morphism property of properness [def-weil-proper-morphism] descends along surjective flat quasi-compact morphisms [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]: for any cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with right vertical arrow g and lower horizontal arrow p, if p is surjective, flat and quasi-compact and the upper horizontal arrow is proper, then g is proper. No finite-type, quasi-separatedness or affineness hypothesis on the schemes is added.
